source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The browser case checks progress Cancel routing through a fake outgoing request and records whether its cancel callback actually ran. Unit cases separately cover active/queued MessageSend status through a fake send callback and direct request cancellation with a fake server. Their expected structures require NS_ERROR_ABORT without reported success, while fixed observation/time-out windows and substituted callbacks limit the coverage. Accepted later production cancellation and preference-setup changes are separate phases; no test was executed.
title: SMTP cancellation tests separate progress routing, queued sends and request status
